other-wet-area-waterproofing-adelaide.ht.source: This service is for an existing moisture-exposed space not covered by the named room services. Describe the room or surface, how it is used and where moisture appears. Moisture beneath tiles can relate to water entry, a supply source, movement or an unsuitable base; the visible mark does not prove concealed membrane failure. We inspect what is accessible and explain whether further opening or another trade assessment is needed before selecting waterproofing.
other-wet-area-waterproofing-adelaide.ht.target: 此服务针对未被具体房间服务覆盖的现有受潮空间。请描述房间或表面、用途及潮湿位置。砖下水分可能来自进水、供水、位移或不适合基层；可见印迹不能证明隐蔽膜层失效。我们检查可接触部分，并说明选择防水前是否需进一步打开或其他工种评估。

other-wet-area-waterproofing-adelaide.ht.source: We define the repair area and assess the base, adjoining dry surfaces, penetrations and retained finishes. We propose a local repair where the existing material and junctions support it. Pool interiors use our separate pool waterproofing service; specialist commercial systems and structural repairs require their own scope. We use the relevant room service when it fits your project.
other-wet-area-waterproofing-adelaide.ht.target: 我们明确维修区域，评估基层、相邻干区、穿透点及保留饰面。现有材料和交接适合时，安排局部修复。泳池内部按独立泳池防水服务处理；专业商业系统及结构维修需单独明确范围。项目属于已有房间服务时，采用对应服务流程。

other-wet-area-waterproofing-adelaide.ht.source: We identify the room use, substrate, drainage and planned finish before selecting the waterproofing layers. Primer, flexible membrane, joint sealant and moisture-control coating serve different roles. We check compatible corners, collars and bond-breaking details instead of assuming every product from one brand can be mixed. The written quote defines preparation, membrane coverage and any protection or tiling included.
other-wet-area-waterproofing-adelaide.ht.target: 我们先确认房间用途、基层、排水及拟定饰面，再选择防水各层材料。底涂、柔性防水膜、接缝密封胶及水分控制涂层各有作用。我们核对相容的转角件、套环和隔粘做法，不默认同品牌的所有产品都能混用。书面报价明确基层处理、防水覆盖范围及包含的保护层或铺砖工作。
